Dates
Thu, Jun 3 – Sun, Jun 6, 2027

Emporia, KS
Distances
XL (~350 mi), 200, 100, 50, 25 miles; Juniors; Kids Crit. XL 350 mi starts Fri June 4 (evening)

mass-participation gravel race / festival

Charity entries via partners (e.g., Chris Klug Foundation ‘CKF UNBOUND’ team; other partners not listed on site)

Life Time

Life Time Grand Prix (200-mile race is round 2)

Lottery. Opens Nov 1, 2026 10:00 AM CT; closes Nov 15, 2026 11:59 PM CT; results Nov 21, 2026. Life Time Club members early access from Oct 25, 2026. One entry per person; registration free to enter (card collected). 2027 entry fees ‘coming soon’.

NotesFormerly Dirty Kanza (renamed 2020). 2027 routes ‘in the works’. Roughly 4,000 riders. Also a Life Time Grand Prix round (UNBOUND 200 presented by Shimano). Unbound XL (350 mi) runs Friday evening June 4 into Saturday.
